prospective_plan.implementation: Derive totality from the sealed acyclic map CFG, literal guarded range/capture facts and fixed checked matrix geometry. Before writing, guard that every non-target source view is disjoint from the fresh owned bank. Target reads must be the same output cell. Only such maps may initialize/update the fresh private bank directly. On an identity tail containing only the same-cell read, scalar copies, empty visits and the final push, retain the existing cell when its current view is already that bank. Every other map retains complete private scratch evaluation and copy.
prospective_plan.critical_safety: A map miss resumes at its exact pre-map source boundary and may retain earlier completed maps. Thus no speculative partial in-place update may reach a miss. Totality, safe same-cell dependence and all preflight pointer/geometry/capture checks are required before the first bank store; uncertain cases keep the old emitter.
